title: Adapting Boltz-2 with limited experimental activity data improves early enrichment in virtual screening
abstract: arXiv:2609.24302v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Virtual screening aims to prioritize active compounds from large chemical libraries within a limited experimental budget. When applying Boltz-2 to virtual screening, a key challenge is how to use limited experimental data from the target assay to improve the prioritization of active compounds. We investigated whether fine-tuning the Boltz-2 affinity heads with a small number of binary activity labels could improve early enrichment of active compounds in hit discovery. We compared fine-tuning with 40-300 labels in a retrospective evaluation on eight MF-PCBA targets. With 300 activity measurements, fine-tuning increased the number of actives in the top 1% by a geometric mean of 1.77-fold across the eight targets and improved average precision (AP) by 2.14-fold relative to the control without fine-tuning. translated_title: 利用有限实验活性数据适配Boltz-2可提升虚拟筛选中的早期富集效果
translated_abstract: 虚拟筛选旨在有限的实验预算内从大型化合物库中优先筛选出活性化合物。在将Boltz-2应用于虚拟筛选时，一个关键挑战是如何利用来自目标实验的有限实验数据来改进活性化合物的优先级排序。我们研究了是否可以通过少量二元活性标签对Boltz-2的亲和力预测头进行微调，从而提高苗头化合物发现中活性化合物的早期富集效果。我们在八个MF-PCBA靶点上的回顾性评估中比较了使用40-300个标签进行微调的效果。在300个活性测量数据的情况下，微调使八个靶点中前1%化合物内的活性化合物数量以几何平均计算提升了1.77倍，与未微调的对照组相比，平均精度（AP）提升了2.14倍。我们还研究了是否可以通过仅对排名靠前的候选子集进行重新打分和重排序，来保留苗头化合物回收率的提升……
tldr: 仅用40-300个二元活性标签微调Boltz-2的亲和力预测头，即可将虚拟筛选中前1%化合物的活性分子数量提升1.77倍、平均精度提升2.14倍，显著改善苗头化合物发现中的早期富集效果。
en_tdlr: Fine-tuning Boltz-2's affinity heads with only 40-300 binary activity labels improves early enrichment in virtual screening, increasing actives in the top 1% by 1.77-fold and average precision by 2.14-fold across eight MF-PCBA targets.
